job.title: Digital Business Consultant eCommerce (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Digital Business Consultant eCommerce – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Digital Business Consultant role needs someone who links business goals and commerce technology – my daily work for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Requirements, process mapping and functional specifications
– Headless commerce, PWA APIs and PIM / ERP integration know-how
– Generative AI tools in analysis and documentation

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Digital Business Consultant eCommerce | Techno-Functional | B2B & B2C Commerce
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant with 5+ years on enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Translates business goals into digital solutions through requirements engineering, stakeholder management, process mapping, gap analysis, functional specifications and UAT, backed by hands-on depth in headless APIs, PWA storefronts and PIM / ERP integration. Works agile in international teams and uses generative AI and LLM tools extensively in analysis, documentation and delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: brandung builds digital products and e-commerce solutions for well-known brands, where strong consulting has to combine business thinking and technical depth. I want to bring my techno-functional commerce experience to an agency that shapes how brands sell digitally. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: Digital Business Consultant eCommerce
en.hook: A Digital Business Consultant in e-commerce has to understand a client's business model and know what the technology can really deliver. That is the combination I bring: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have worked between business stakeholders and development on large B2B and B2C commerce platforms, from requirements to production.

bullets.label: Digital business consulting
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders: analysed requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Process & requirements
bullets.text: Gathered business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: Technology know-how
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce and PWA frontends and PIM data pipelines across global channels.

bullets.label: AI in delivery
bullets.text: Used generative AI and LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation.
